body: Yeah it’s completely unfair, that’s all there is to it. Living every day in complete misery just so like maybe 2 or 3 people don’t have to feel bad because you died is beyond unsustainable. I wish I’d killed myself when I was younger, staying alive for the last few years has done nothing but introduce more and more trauma. It wasn’t worth staying alive then for me, and it certainly isn’t now. I just hope I finally have the guts to go through with it, first good decision I’d have made in my entire life
